design: Tall slender adult female herald with an oval cranial crest, delicate pointed lower mandibles and thin long dreadlocks swept to the right shoulder. Ivory long wrap robe with a broad red angular stole and short structured shoulder collar, tiny bronze seal hanging at waist. Both hands open a small blank ceremonial proclamation scroll at chest, gaze lowered slightly. Deep brown spotted hide.
